(1) The term of office of the members of the Board

column1: shall be three years : Provided that a member appointed in
place of a member who resigns or otherwise vacates office,
shall hold office for the unexpired part of the term of office of
the member whom he succeeds.

column2: (2) A person shall be disqualified from being appointed or

column1: from  continuing  as  Chairman  of  the  Institute  if  he  is,  or
becomes, the owner, a partner, a director, a majority shareholder
or an employee of, or in, any business, which provides training
in  tourist  services  of  any  class  or  description  and  in  hotel
management.

column2: (3) Any member who vacates office by effluxion of time

column1: shall be eligible for re-appointment.

column2: (4) The Minister may remove any member of the Board

column1: from office, for reasons assigned.

column2: (a) Any member of the Board may resign from office

column1: by letter addressed to the Minister.

column2: (b) Where a member is temporarily unable to discharge

column1: the duties of his office on account of ill health, absence from
Sri Lanka or any other cause, the Minister may appoint some
other person to act as a member in his place for the period of
his absence.

column2: (6 ) The Board may with the approval of the Minister,

column1: appoint such officers or servants to assist the Board in carrying
out its duties under this Part.

column2: (7)  Where necessary, the Members of the Board and other

column1: officers and servants may be paid such remuneration out of
the fund as may be determined by the Authority.
